clusters.name: Interior Anchor
clusters.desc: Players with solid minutes focused on rim protection and rebounding in the paint. They feature the highest block rates and defensive rebound rates, serving as the main anchor of the interior defense.

clusters.name: Secondary Playmaker
clusters.desc: Players with high ball-distribution skills serving as the team's secondary offensive engine. Assist ratios and percentages are well above league average, showcasing an ability to create opportunities for teammates without dominating possession. Common among combo guards and two-way point forwards.

clusters.name: Pure 3PT Shooter
clusters.desc: Players whose offensive contributions come almost entirely from three-point shots. They feature the highest three-point attempt volumes per 36 minutes in the league, alongside low assist and usage rates. Their primary role is spacing the floor and punishing loose perimeter defense.

clusters.name: Two-Way Energy Wing
clusters.desc: Players with standout defensive contributions and high hustle rates. Steals per 36 minutes and offensive rebound percentages are above league average, coupled with competitive defensive ratings. Commonly provides high energy off the bench or key perimeter defense.

clusters.name: Stretch Big
clusters.desc: Modern big men combining rebounding and interior defense with mid-range or three-point shooting threats. Their presence opens up driving lanes for guards by pulling opposing bigs out of the paint, making them a crucial component of modern spacing offenses.

clusters.name: Franchise Cornerstone
clusters.desc: Core players with a dominant impact across all aspects of the game. Points per 36 minutes, assists, free throw attempts, and offensive ratings are all at elite levels. High usage rates indicate heavy team reliance as the primary offensive option, representing All-Star caliber franchise cornerstones.

clusters.name: Bench Rotation Piece
clusters.desc: End-of-bench rotation players with very low minutes. They play limited minutes to fill rotation slots and record minimal statistical production across almost all major categories.
